prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 版本更新日志（中英混排） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "版本" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 43px
  col 2: header "日期" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 87px
  col 3: header "类型" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "变更内容" · longest unbreakable word 90px · one-line width 646px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录各版本的发布日期、更新类型和具体变更，供读者查看版本演进。","reading":"读者可先按版本或日期定位，再扫描类型和变更内容；同一行的元数据与说明需要保持清晰的对应关系。","groups":["版本与日期共同标识一次发布，适合并置比较。","类型与变更内容共同说明更新性质；类型是短标签，内容是主要阅读区域。"],"keep_intact":["版本号及其字母、数字和标点","日期中的数字片段","WebSocket、OAuth、OpenSSL 等英文术语及版本号","修复、新功能、性能、安全等类型标签宜尽量保持完整"],"may_wrap":["变更内容可在中文词句及英文术语之间自然换行。","日期可在连字符处换行，但会降低纵向扫描效率。","内容说明形成的行高可容纳同一行中类型或日期的换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [64, 72, 66, 157] · table 360×461px · row heights [36, 106, 129, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [64, 64, 66, 165] · table 360×461px · row heights [36, 106, 129, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [64, 80, 66, 149] · table 360×485px · row heights [36, 106, 153, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"版本号完整，日期均分成两行，纵向扫描较一致；变更内容有足够空间容纳英文术语，行与行之间的对应关系清楚。","problems":"“新功能”被拆成两行，削弱了类型列作为短标签的作用；日期换行也使发布日期不易直接比较。","cause":"类型列66px的文本空间比该标签所需的46px少1px；日期列72px不足以容纳完整日期。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"变更内容列稍宽，部分中文说明的换行更从容；版本号和英文术语保持完整。","problems":"日期的换行方式不一致，最后一条分成三行，纵向比较更费力；“新功能”仍被拆开。内容列增加的空间没有缩短整表。","cause":"日期列从72px收窄到64px，部分日期无法保持月日同一行；类型列仍为66px。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"日期列较宽，日期均以相同方式分成两行；版本号完整，元数据与说明的对应关系仍然清楚。","problems":"变更内容更加拥挤，第二条说明达到六行，整表变高；“新功能”仍被拆开。日期增加的宽度没有换来单行显示。","cause":"日期列增至80px仍不足以容纳完整日期，而内容列缩至149px；类型列仍为66px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-label","widths":[64,72,67,156],"change":"以r2A为基础，将类型列加宽1px，让“新功能”有机会保持单行；从内容列借用1px，保留较一致的两行日期。"},{"name":"content-first","widths":[64,70,67,158],"change":"保持完整版本号和类型标签，将日期列收窄2px，给变更内容更多空间；检查日期是否仍能一致地分成两行。"},{"name":"single-line-dates","widths":[64,108,67,120],"change":"让完整日期和类型标签各占一行，便于纵向比较；内容列明显收窄，用以检验元数据更易扫描是否值得增加说明的换行。"}]}
